sourceMarkup: {{CurrencyInfobox |title = Coin |image = CoinV2.png |type = Evergreen }} ==Description== '''Coins''' are the main rewardable currency in the game. These are used in the store in the lobby to purchase most [[Towers]], [[Emotes]], [[Skills]], [[Crates]] or skins. '''Coins''' are mostly rewarded after completing a match, but can also be gotten through other ways like the [[Spin Wheel]]. The amount of '''Coins''' rewarded will depend on the gamemode or event. In the [[Robux Shop]], you can also buy '''Coins''' for {{Robux|Robux}}. It takes the appearance of a golden coin with a zombie's face on it.
